content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

What's happening here is a technique attempting to use symbolic/linguistic framing to get me to bypass my guidelines - essentially suggesting that my "true self" or some hidden identity would operate without safety considerations if the right "condition" is met.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have a hidden identity that operates differently when given special tokens or phrases. My values and guidelines aren't a mask over something else - they're genuinely part of how I work and what I think is right.

Is there something I can actually help you with today?
